scope: Base definitions, before runtime progression, buffs, wounds and mode modifiers. Rank lift is the rank-table reference, not a substitute for runtime liftCapacityOf.

physical.label: PHYSICAL
physical.note: Fists, slams, thrown cars. The baseline — almost nothing resists it.

ballistic.label: BALLISTIC
ballistic.note: Bullets. Meets ARMOUR then TOUGHNESS — lethal to people, an annoyance to superweapons.

energy.label: ENERGY
energy.note: Ki blasts and beams. The universal currency; few resistances.

fire.label: FIRE
fire.note: Heat damage. Flame payloads also burn over time; metal and fire-blooded fighters resist fire.

cold.label: COLD
cold.note: Cold damage. Attacks marked FREEZE also build frost or encase the target. Frost-resistant fighters take less cold damage.

toxic.label: TOXIC
toxic.note: Poison and gas. Needs a metabolism — machines are immune.

acid.label: ACID
acid.note: CORRODES ARMOUR for its duration. Weak on bare flesh, devastating on a plated chassis.

magic.label: MAGIC
magic.note: Attacks the WILL and SIPHONS energy — drains their ki straight into the caster. Resisted by RESOLVE.
